utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, I'll mark my calendar. Gus and I are meeting tomorrow to organize tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli. I'll bring my tool kit and we can sort through everything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, see you tomorrow morning then. I'll have the coffee ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Jules! The repair drive—I remember now, broken items this Saturday at the community center. I'll check my garage for that old toaster!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Oren! I bet you'll find plenty of volunteers to help with that toaster. Maybe we can even get Pia involved—she was asking about supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Pia? Oh, good idea! She's great with tools—I think I saw her fixing a fence last week. I'll bring the toaster and see what she thinks!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would be great, Pia. So it's from 10 to 4, right? Just want to double-check.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, 10 to 4 is correct. But I'm still worried we might not have enough supplies—should we ask for more donations?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good point about supplies. Maybe I can check with Vik if he knows where we might get extra parts or tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mara, are you going to the repair drive this Saturday? I'm bringing my broken lamp.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Nell! I'll be there too, and we'll get that lamp fixed up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's wonderful! I'm so glad you'll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds cool, maybe I'll swing by if I have time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You should check it out—I've got a flyer with all the details if you want a copy.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nah, I'm good. I'll probably just glance at the info online if I get a sec.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Quinn, do you have any spare tools or parts we could use for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I've got a few spare wrenches and a box of screws. Want me to bring them to Faye's garage?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, yes please! Drop-off is after 3:15 at Faye's garage.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Dane! I'm glad you asked. The repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center – could you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sunday? Got it, I'll let folks know. Thanks for the update, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane! I really appreciate your help—it makes a big difference for the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Vik, glad you're bringing your blender on Saturday! I'll be there too to help fix things up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh yeah, I almost forgot—Jules is bringing a blender too! Should be a good turn-out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, the more blenders the merrier! I'll be there to help fix them up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time is the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think Rosa said it's on Sunday, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday at 10? I thought it was Saturday. Are you sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rey! I'm mapping out the route for the repair drive this Saturday. Do you have anything you'd like fixed?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I thought the repair drive was this Saturday, but Quinn mentioned it's Friday evening. Are you sure it's Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm certain Vik said Saturday at the community center. Did Quinn mention a different time? I'd better double-check.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo! I'm organizing a repair drive this month. Do you have any broken electronics you'd like to donate?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I have a few items. I'll bring them to the repair drive this Saturday at my garage.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, the drop-off is at my garage, 123 Maple Street, on weekdays after 3:15 PM. Thanks for contributing!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Tess, I still haven't seen that list of supplies you mentioned. Can you show it to me before we go any further?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, sorry Kira, I totally forgot to grab it! Let me run home and fetch it—I'll be right back!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, I'll wait. But make it quick, I don't have all day.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Morning, Gus! You going to bring anything for the repair drive tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes, I'll be bringing my toolbox. I'm happy to help fix what I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's great, Gus! We'll need all the tools we can get.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Leo, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? I got a flyer with all the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Wait, is it Saturday? Quinn mentioned it might be Friday evening. Do you know for sure?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it's definitely Saturday. The flyer says 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Faye! Are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? I'm mapping out the route and could use any details you have.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, the drive is on Saturday but I'm accepting drop-offs at my garage starting Monday after 3 PM if that helps your route planning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Monday drop-offs? That's good to know for later, but I'm planning the route for Saturday. Are you free to help on Saturday itself?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mina! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? It's from 10 to 4, and they'll fix your stuff for free!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought it was Sunday at 10. Are you sure about Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh no, it's definitely Saturday! I double-checked the flyer just this morning. It's Saturday from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I just messaged Nell about Saturday! I need to correct that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh no, want me to send a quick correction to Nell for you? I don't mind!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, but I'll fix it myself. I'll send her a quick note.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Oren, sorry I'm late—got waylaid by a leaky faucet at home. So what's the plan here?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, no worries, Dane! I was just heading to the garage to see if I can find that old toaster for the repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: A toaster, huh? I bet Gus can fix that in no time—he's got a knack for small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Noah, are you planning to go to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Oh right, is that this Saturday? I keep losing track of days.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, it's this Saturday morning at the community center. You should come, it'll be fun!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I saw a flyer—people fixing stuff for free, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You saw a flyer? Well, I still haven't seen that list of supplies or what exactly we're supposed to be fixing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sorry, I didn't look that closely at the flyer—maybe check the community board again?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Sam! I heard you're interested in the repair drive? It's this Saturday at the community center, just so you know!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I'm planning to bring my old blender! I'm looking forward to it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, a blender! I heard Jules is bringing one too. Maybe we can get some tips from the fixers on how to keep them running longer.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara! Are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Jules! I'll be there—I've got a couple of things to fix myself.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great! What are you thinking of bringing? I'm trying to figure out if I need any extra parts for my blender.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I don't really have anything to bring, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: No worries, Uli. Just having extra hands is helpful. But are we sure we have enough tools and materials in the common stash?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm not sure about the stash, but I could help sort if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Vik! Just a heads-up, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday! I'll make sure to tell everyone it's Sunday now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for helping spread the word, Vik! See you Sunday.
